title: San Francisco, GGB, Muir Woods and Sausalito Private Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Infants can participate in this tour but the parent traveling with the infant must provide their own Child Car Seat.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Take a trip around San Francisco in a luxury Lincoln Sedan. Our tours can accommodate up to 4 people, it is a private tour. Book with our friendly and informative tour guides today for SF ultimate experience.
This Tour will take you across the Golden Gate Bridge to walk among old-growth coast redwoods of the famous Muir Woods National Monument Park and admire the beautiful seaside Mediterranean style City of Sausalito. On the Muir Woods and Sausalito Tour, you will cross one of the most famous landmarks, the Golden Gate Bridge, while you could admire the Art Deco style of The Bridge and the skyline of San Francisco, the Bay, and Alcatraz Island. We will be heading the Muir Woods National Monument through the coastal mountains of the Marin Headlands along with the Mount Tamalpais.
Muir Woods National Monument
You have a free walk of 1 hour and 15 minutes to see the world's impressive highest trees and feel the magic atmosphere while you enter "quietly in the Cathedral Groove."
